## Setup

Install the packages the examples use (once), and set the graphics scheme:

::: {.panel-tabset group="language"}
## Stata

```stata
net install cleanplots, from("https://tdmize.github.io/data") replace
ssc install coefplot, replace
ssc install combomarginsplot, replace
ssc install binscatter, replace
ssc install estout, replace

// cleanplots: https://www.trentonmize.com/software/cleanplots
set scheme cleanplots
```

## R

```r
install.packages(c("foreign", "ggplot2", "dplyr", "marginaleffects",
  "modelsummary", "Hmisc", "remotes"))
library(remotes)                      # installs packages from GitHub
install_github("tdmize/cleanplots")   # Mize's graphics scheme
```

Each page starts by loading the packages it uses and setting the
[**cleanplots**](/software/cleanplots_r/index.qmd) theme:

```r
library(cleanplots)         # Mize's graphics scheme

## Use cleanplots colors, markers, lines, and theme for all graphs ##
cleanplots_defaults()
theme_update(plot.title.position = "plot")   # titles start at left edge of graph
```

:::
